framework_title: An Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Fusion Framework for Subsea Cable Disturbance Assessment

controlled_simulation.name: Controlled Simulation Benchmark
controlled_simulation.key_finding: Decoupled physical disturbance detection from vessel attribution with reliable fail-closed TX handling.

real_das.name: Real Submarine Fiber DAS Deployments
real_das.total_duration_evaluated: 27.6 days Arctic + 1,050 s deep-sea + 10 min North Sea wind farm
real_das.key_finding: No T2/T3 vessel-escalation decisions occurred during the evaluated Arctic environmental recording; Spearman rho = 0.9482 proximity correlation on North Sea export cable.

hardware_in_the_loop.name: AbyssLink Hardware-in-the-Loop Bridge

hardware_in_the_loop.key_finding: Validates real-time protocol decoding, timing, and optical fault detection with synthesized 50 Hz MPU6050 accelerometer.
